search_notes: ITM topline release of 28 Jan 2025 (GlobeNewswire, read via a wire repost): COMPETE met PFS vs everolimus, no numbers. HR first shown at ENETS 2025 (5-7 Mar; CancerNetwork coverage opened is dated 6 Mar 2025): mPFS 23.9 vs 14.1 mo, HR 0.67 (0.48-0.95), p=0.022. Lancet paper announced 7 Jul 2026 and registry results posted 2026-04-06 (both seen in search summary only). Open-label, active comparator.

which_endpoint: EFS by investigator (Arm A sasanlimab + BCG induction and maintenance vs Arm C BCG)
search_notes: Pfizer topline release of 10 Jan 2025: CREST met EFS, no numbers. pfizer.com returns 403 to scripts, so the release itself was not opened; the earliest copy opened is an OncoDaily write-up dated 12 Jan 2025, and the 10 Jan date is from an Applied Clinical Trials article of 28 Apr 2025 (https://appliedclinicaltrialsonline.com/view/pivotal-phaseiii-trial-data-pfizer-sasanlimab-bcg-improves-event-free-survival-bladder-cancer) and a Pharma Letter item seen in a search summary. HR in the Pfizer release of 26 Apr 2025 for the AUA 2025 plenary (wire repost opened).

No result found for the first-line pancreatic phase 3 of HR070803 (Hengrui irinotecan liposome): one English/Chinese web search and PubMed returned only the second-line trial (PAN-HEROIC-1) and a phase 1; the 26 Hengrui filing-acceptance and trial notices carried on HKEX from May 2025 to Oct 2026 were opened and none concerns irinotecan liposome or pancreatic cancer. Not checked: Shanghai exchange notices before Hengrui's May 2025 Hong Kong listing, and 2025-2026 conference abstracts (web-search budget ran out). Registry stale (status unknown, last update May 2024, study completion estimated 2025-12).

which_endpoint: PFS by investigator (dual primary with OS; OS immature at first disclosure)
search_notes: Merck release of 19 Jul 2023: KEYNOTE-A18 met PFS at a prespecified interim analysis, OS favourable trend but immature, no numbers. HR first shown at ESMO 2023 (coverage dated 20 Oct 2023): PFS HR 0.70 (0.55-0.89), OS HR 0.73 (0.49-1.07). The OS primary was reported as met at a later interim analysis in 2024; that later disclosure was not traced here. Registry primary completion date (2025-01-07) is 18 months after the first disclosure.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR in the ESR1-mutant population (met); PFS by BICR in all randomised (dual primary, not met)
search_notes: Arvinas/Pfizer topline of 11 Mar 2025 (Arvinas 8-K): VERITAC-2 met PFS in the ESR1-mutant population (exceeded the target HR of 0.60) but did not reach significance in the intent-to-treat population; no HR value. Recorded as met because either primary sufficed. HR on 31 May 2025 with ASCO 2025 and the simultaneous NEJM paper (PMID 40454645, doi 10.1056/NEJMoa2505725): ESR1m 0.58 (0.43-0.78); all patients 0.83 (0.69-1.01), p=0.07. Open-label vs fulvestrant.

No result found for STEMNESS-PANC (GB201, earlier registered as napabucasin, plus weekly paclitaxel and low-dose gemcitabine; phase 2/3): web search by acronym, drug names and sponsor, and PubMed, returned only the registry and older napabucasin trials (CanStem111P, stopped for futility in 2019, is a different trial). 1Globe issues no press releases that I could find. Registry status unknown, last update Apr 2024; an EU CTIS entry (seen in search summary only) lists the trial as ongoing, recruitment ended.

which_endpoint: PFS by investigator, durvalumab + olaparib arm vs control, non-tBRCAm (full analysis set and HRD-positive)
search_notes: AstraZeneca high-level results of 5 Apr 2023 (the April URL on astrazeneca.com was not found; read via a dated Medthority copy): DUO-O met PFS at a planned interim analysis for durvalumab + olaparib + chemotherapy + bevacizumab; the durvalumab-only arm was numerically better but not significant; no numbers. HR in the AstraZeneca release of 3 Jun 2023 for ASCO LBA5506: full analysis set 0.63 (0.52-0.76), HRD-positive 0.49 (0.34-0.69); HR cells hold the full-analysis-set value. Registry primary completion date (2025-03-17) is almost two years after the first disclosure; final OS (not significant) at ESMO 2025 per search summary.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR (met); OS (dual primary, not statistically significant)
search_notes: Summit topline release of 30 May 2025 (8-K exhibit 99.1): HARMONi met PFS, HR 0.52 (0.41-0.66), p<0.00001; OS HR 0.79 (0.62-1.01), p=0.057, not significant. Recorded as met on one of two dual primaries, with OS missed; could be argued as mixed. A later OS update (HR 0.76, nominal) was posted in Jul 2026 (search summary). The registry record covers the multiregional trial, which pools the Chinese HARMONi-A patients; do not confuse with HARMONi-A's own readouts.

which_endpoint: PFS by IRF (PD-L1-positive analysis set and full analysis set)
search_notes: No Roche press release. First disclosure is the Roche HY 2025 results presentation of 24 Jul 2025: the tiragolumab study slide for SKYSCRAPER-03 (NCT04513925) says 'Primary endpoint of PFS not met July 2025' and the pipeline-changes slide lists tiragolumab + T in stage III unresectable NSCLC under 'Removed from phase III'. The Q1 2025 presentation (24 Apr 2025) still listed the trial as ongoing; the half-year media release does not mention it. ApexOnco reported it the same day. HR at ESMO 2025 (LBA69; OncLive coverage dated 18 Oct 2025): PD-L1-positive 0.96 (0.75-1.23), full analysis set 1.00 (0.84-1.19); HR cells hold the PD-L1-positive value. Open-label vs durvalumab.

ELEVATE (BTP-42338), prespecified interim analysis presented at ESMO 2025 as LBA66 (mini oral, 17-21 Oct 2025): DFS HR 0.20 (0.11-0.38) in stage II-IIIB. The ESMO Daily Reporter page renders by script; the text and a 2025-10-20 date were read from its embedded data, so the day is uncertain by one or two days. A report of Betta's 25 Nov 2025 Shenzhen filing on the NMPA acceptance says the data were first disclosed at ESMO 2025; no earlier Betta notice was found, but Shenzhen exchange notices were not searched directly. NEJM paper 8 Jul 2026; NMPA approval 3 Sep 2026 (search summary). Registry stale (status unknown, last update Aug 2024).

CStone HKEX voluntary announcement of 4 Jul 2025 (22:30): final analysis of CS1003-305 showed a 'compelling trend' in OS for nofazinlimab + lenvatinib 'despite not reaching statistical significance'; PFS and ORR improved; no numbers. No HR found: the ClinicalTrials.gov results posted 2026-07-30 give median OS 21.6 vs 18.5 months but, as retrieved through the registry API, no hazard-ratio analysis for OS. No conference presentation was searched for (web-search budget ran out).

First disclosure is one sentence in the Sino Biopharm HKEX notice of 10 Jul 2025 on the NMPA accepting the first-line filing for culmerciclib (TQB3616): 'TQB3616-III-02 ... The study has met its primary endpoint'. The notice prints NCT04523272 beside the protocol number, not NCT05365178; matched on protocol number, design and population. Data (interim analysis, CULMINATE-2) at ESMO 2025 as LBA25; Sino Biopharm HKEX notice of 21 Oct 2025 gives HR 0.56, p=0.0004, without CI; CI 0.40-0.78 is in HMP coverage dated 29 Oct 2025. The exact ESMO session day was not confirmed, so the HR date may be 1-3 days late. NMPA approval May 2026 (search summary).

CSPC HKEX voluntary announcement of 10 Jun 2026 (Alphamab issued the same notice that day): KN026-003 (KN026 + HB1801 vs trastuzumab + pertuzumab + docetaxel, first-line HER2+ breast cancer) met PFS as assessed by the IDMC, with an OS trend; no numbers, data promised for a coming conference. No HR found. Beware siblings: KN026-004 (neoadjuvant, met tpCR, 31 Mar 2026) and KN026-001 (gastric, met PFS, 30 Apr 2025). Registry still says recruiting (last update May 2025). Open-label, active comparator.

which_endpoint: PFS at 6 months (Cohort A, phase 2 part)
search_notes: Disclosed inside Recursion's Q1 2025 results release of 5 May 2025 (wire repost opened; same wording in the 10-Q per search summary): REC-2282 in NF2 meningioma discontinued - 'Phase 2 passed the futility threshold primarily driven by the 40mg cohort, however the 60mg and combined dose arms did not pass the futility criteria ... limited overall tumor shrinkage and clinical activity ... Totality of data supports the discontinuation'. Recorded as stopped_futility, but the analysis was of the uncontrolled phase 2 dose cohorts (25 enrolled); the placebo-controlled phase 3 part never ran, so terminated_no_analysis is arguable. Registry says only 'sponsor decision'. Phase 2/3 design; review for exclusion.

Hinova (Shanghai STAR 688302) announced on 26 Jun 2022 that the China phase 3 of HC-1119 (deutenzalutamide, earlier 'deenlutamide') met its primary endpoint at a prespecified interim analysis judged by the IDMC, rPFS significant, OS trend only; read on the company news page dated 27 Jun 2022 (the exchange notice itself was not opened). HR first found in company coverage of ASCO 2023 abstract 5065 (poster 3 Jun 2023; page opened dated 8 Jun 2023): 0.58 (0.439-0.770). Paper: Signal Transduct Target Ther 2026-04-13 (PMID 41968137, doi 10.1038/s41392-026-02618-3), which names NCT03851640 / HC-1119-04. Registry is badly stale: still 'recruiting' with primary completion estimated 2025-09, three years after the readout. Month-only registry date taken as the 15th.

Rakuten Medical release of 30 May 2026 for an ASCO 2026 poster of ASP-1929-301 (data cutoff 30 Apr 2025, 135 randomised): PFS 3.2 vs 3.1 months, HR 0.98 ('similar'); OS 15.7 vs 9.6 months, HR 0.83 ('longer numerical trend'); no CIs or p-values and no statement that either primary endpoint was met, so recorded as not_met. HR cells hold PFS. The ASCO abstract page (asco.org/abstracts-presentations/261461) returned 403 and probably went online about a week earlier. No topline release found on the company's 2025-2026 press pages (first archive page only for 2025). Month-only registry date taken as the 15th. Open-label.

BRIGHT-3 (XZP-3287 / bireociclib + letrozole or anastrozole). Earliest statement of the result opened is Xuanzhu's Hong Kong listing document (post-hearing information pack, 17 Sep 2025; same text in the prospectus of 6 Oct 2025): 'Based on positive results in an interim analysis, we submitted the NDA to the NMPA in April 2025, which was accepted in May 2025' - it does not use the words 'primary endpoint'. Sihuan's HKEX notice of 9 Jun 2025 on the NDA acceptance gives no result; an earlier application proof of the listing document may carry the same sentence and was not found. Data as an ESMO 2025 poster on 20 Oct 2025 (Xuanzhu HKEX notice of 22 Oct 2025): 47% reduction in risk of progression or death, medians not reached vs 18.43 months; no HR with CI found, so HR cells are blank. NMPA approval 3 Mar 2026.

LIVERATION not read out: Can-Fite's press-release list (opened; titles only) shows a 2 Sep 2026 item 'Longer-Than-Anticipated Overall Survival in Ongoing Pivotal Phase III Liver Cancer Study' and a Q2 2026 results item on 8 Sep 2026, both describing the study as ongoing; no interim or topline result. Registry recruiting, last update Apr 2025. Releases themselves not opened.

AstraZeneca release of 29 Apr 2025 (also a 'new disclosure' row in the Q1 2025 results announcement of the same day): CAPItello-280 discontinued on the IDMC's recommendation after a prespecified interim analysis concluded capivasertib + docetaxel was unlikely to meet the dual primary endpoints of rPFS and OS. No numbers and no HR found. This is 10 months before the registry's estimated primary completion date; registry record not updated since Jan 2025. Sibling CAPItello-281 (hormone-sensitive, met rPFS) is a different trial.

No result found for AK104-305 / COMPASSION-18 (cadonilimab + chemoradiotherapy, locally advanced cervical cancer): web search in English and Chinese found only safety run-in data (SGO, Mar 2025); Akeso's HKEX announcement titles from Oct 2025 to Oct 2026 and its 2026 interim results (27 Aug 2026) contain no readout. Results for AK104-303 (recurrent/metastatic, met PFS Nov 2023) are a different trial. Registry last updated Aug 2024.

which_endpoint: PFS by BICR, PIK3CA wild-type cohort (gedatolisib + palbociclib + fulvestrant vs fulvestrant)
search_notes: Celcuity topline release of 28 Jul 2025 (8-K exhibit 99.1) for the PIK3CA wild-type cohort: both primary comparisons met - triplet vs fulvestrant HR 0.24 (0.17-0.35), doublet vs fulvestrant HR 0.33 (0.24-0.48). The registry lists one primary outcome covering both the wild-type and the mutant cohort; the mutant cohort (triplet vs alpelisib + fulvestrant) was reported positive in about May 2026 with data at ASCO 2026 (search summary only, not opened). The row describes the first cohort; the lag is negative because the registry date tracks the mutant cohort.

MONO-OLA1 not read out as far as could be checked: AstraZeneca's clinical trials appendices for FY2025, Q1 2026 and H1 2026 (the last dated July 2026) all say 'Data anticipated: H2 2026'. AstraZeneca press releases from August to early October 2026 could not be listed (the press page loads by script and the web-search budget had run out), so a topline in the last ten weeks is possible. Registry active, not recruiting, last update Mar 2026.

CANOVA (M13-494). AbbVie release of 29 Sep 2023 (wire repost opened) with the International Myeloma Society presentation: VenDex did not significantly improve PFS vs PomDex, HR 0.823 (0.596-1.136), p=0.237. No earlier topline found; AbbVie's 2023 quarterly releases were not checked. JCO paper 2025 (doi 10.1200/jco-25-00924, search summary). Registry primary completion is still estimated for 2026-08 (taken as the 15th), three years after the readout. Open-label, active comparator.

No result found for HE071-031 (mitoxantrone liposome + capecitabine, nasopharyngeal carcinoma): CSPC's HKEX announcement titles from 2023 to Oct 2026 show only 'first patient dosed' (2 Mar 2023), the CSPC 2026 interim results (20 Aug 2026) list no readout for this indication, and PubMed has only a phase 1b. No web search was run (budget ran out). Registry never updated since Feb 2023 (still 'not yet recruiting').

Hansoh HKEX voluntary announcement of 10 Jul 2026: ARTEMIS-008 (HS-20093, risvutatug rezetecan, vs topotecan in relapsed SCLC) met OS at a prespecified interim analysis; no numbers, data promised for a coming conference. BLA accepted by the NMPA on 2 Sep 2026 and given priority review on 11 Sep 2026 (HKEX titles). No HR found; conference abstracts were not searched (budget ran out). Disclosed 12 weeks before the registry's estimated primary completion date; registry still says recruiting (last update Oct 2024). Sibling: the osteosarcoma phase 3 of HS-20093 met its endpoint on 28 Jul 2026. Open-label.

HB1901-008 not read out: the trial was registered in Apr 2025 as not yet recruiting, and CSPC's HKEX announcement titles to Oct 2026 and its 2026 interim results show no result for sirolimus (albumin-bound) in breast cancer. The CSPC notices of Apr and Jul 2026 (phase 1b/3 met its primary endpoint; NDA accepted) concern a different trial, in malignant PEComa.
